tasks.short: Check hydroelectric operations against prescribed operating limits.

steps.what: Verify actual operating readings and the applicable approved load, voltage and temperature limits
inputs: actual hydroelectric historian readings
existing prescribed operating limits and equipment configuration
outputs: manager-checked readings and applicable limit version

steps.what: Compare checked readings with limits in a native periodic operating compliance view
inputs: manager-checked readings and applicable limit version
approved comparison period and unit mappings
outputs: manager-checked operating limit exceptions and missing readings

steps.what: Investigate actual exceptions and judge whether operations comply with prescribed limits
inputs: manager-checked operating limit exceptions and missing readings
actual equipment and operating context
outputs: manager operating compliance findings and required actions

steps.what: Write and approve actual operating compliance findings, source times and unresolved issues
inputs: manager operating compliance findings and required actions
outputs: approved final actual operating compliance record

steps.what: Save the approved final operating compliance record
inputs: approved final actual operating compliance record
outputs: saved actual operating compliance record

tasks.design: Configure a native periodic comparison in {PLANT_HISTORIAN}, denoted OTHER, using prescribed limits. Existing real-time alarms, interlocks and control functions are baseline and get no benefit. Manager verifies readings, investigates exceptions and writes the final finding. Same-system save is separate and unchanged.
tasks.previous_blocker: Periodic compliance checking may still involve manual reading-to-limit comparisons beyond current alarms.
tasks.enabler_now: Native historian comparisons can flag exact periodic exceptions and missing readings.
tasks.still_hard: Determining the applicable limit and interpreting equipment conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The manager recognises when an apparently acceptable reading is unreliable or incomplete.
tasks.altitude: Human operating compliance checks with exact periodic comparison.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: historian systems can compare actual timestamped readings with configured numeric limits.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Observe any residual periodic manual comparison after existing historian and SCADA functions; existing alarm runtime earns no new saving. If those comparisons already exist, this proposed benefit disappears.

Existing sensors/historian supply equipment_id, timestamp, value, units and quality_status; engineering owner supplies prescribed limit_version and bound. s1 retains actual verification and missing-value handling; s2 retains 12.5 hours for mapping and exception checks. Missing or conflicting data uses manual checking.

s4 captures actual compliance_result, evidence_times and unresolved_issue at full time. No control setting, alarm acknowledgement, trip or operating release is automated. Same-system save remains full.
research_questions: Which periodic limit comparisons remain manual beyond current alarms and historian reports?

incremental.description: Maintain prescribed limit versions, units and periodic comparison mappings

approvals.approved_version: s4 actual final operating compliance record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only residual comparison changes: 25 times 50% = 12.5 hours less 1 upkeep = 11.5. Low halves comparison benefit: 6.25 minus 1 = 5.25.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and implement projects improving hydroelectric plant efficiency, economy or effectiveness.

steps.what: Define the actual plant improvement need and verify operating, cost and project constraints
inputs: actual operating evidence and improvement need
existing cost records, engineering constraints and project requirements
outputs: manager-checked project source set and alternatives

steps.what: Compare exact cost and schedule scenarios in the native project planning workbook
inputs: manager-checked project source set and alternatives
manager-entered explicit scenario assumptions
outputs: manager-checked project scenario comparisons

steps.what: Judge feasibility and develop or oversee implementation of the selected improvement project
inputs: manager-checked project scenario comparisons
actual engineering advice, approvals and implementation observations
outputs: actual project decisions, implementation progress and observed outcomes

steps.what: Write and approve the actual project plan or progress record and explicit outcome limits
inputs: actual project decisions, implementation progress and observed outcomes
manager-checked project source set and alternatives
outputs: approved final actual hydroelectric project record

steps.what: Save the approved final hydroelectric project record
inputs: approved final actual hydroelectric project record
outputs: saved actual hydroelectric project record

tasks.design: Configure exact scenario formulas in the existing {PROJECT_PLANNER} or {SPREADSHEET}. OTHER denotes the existing plant operating records. Manager supplies actual sources and explicit assumptions, judges feasibility and oversees development/implementation. The record distinguishes planned from actual outcomes; same-system save remains full.
tasks.previous_blocker: Cost and schedule alternatives may be recomputed manually for project review.
tasks.enabler_now: Native workbook scenarios can reuse checked figures and explicit assumptions.
tasks.still_hard: Engineering feasibility, outage coordination and delivering an improvement.
tasks.human_edge: The manager judges whether a numerically attractive scenario works at the plant.
tasks.altitude: Human improvement projects with exact scenario arithmetic.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native project workbooks can recalculate explicit cost and schedule scenarios.

assumptions: All shares are provisional for a development/implementation work cycle. Credit only residual repeated scenario arithmetic after current formulas; no project outcome is assumed or counted as labour saving.

s1 captures/checks actual_cost_sources, available_outage_window and engineering_constraints; manager enters explicit scenario_quantity, rate, duration and assumption_source in s1-s2 at retained time. No invented historical baseline, saving or price is supplied. Missing sources uses manual analysis.

s2 retains 7.5 hours for formula/assumption checking; s3 retains full practical work and actual authorisation coordination. s4 captures actual phase, decision and observed_result at full time. Same-system save remains full; no capital purchase or commissioning release is automatically issued.
unknowns: Actual project phase and comparison burden
research_questions: Which cost or schedule comparisons are still recalculated by hand after current project tools?

incremental.description: Maintain project scenario formulas and assumption-source checks

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final actual project record with phase and outcome limits

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only scenario arithmetic changes: 15 times 50% = 7.5 hours less 1 upkeep = 6.5. Low halves arithmetic benefit: 3.75 minus 1 = 2.75.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide technical direction for hydroelectric equipment erection and commissioning.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify current erection drawings, commissioning procedures and equipment requirements through native links
inputs: existing current erection drawings and commissioning procedures
actual equipment identification and configuration
outputs: manager-checked erection and commissioning source set

steps.what: Inspect actual erection or commissioning conditions and determine the appropriate technical direction
inputs: manager-checked erection and commissioning source set
actual electrical and mechanical work conditions
outputs: manager technical direction decisions and constraints

steps.what: Write and approve the complete final technical instruction, limits and internal crew recipients
inputs: manager technical direction decisions and constraints
manager-checked erection and commissioning source set
outputs: approved final commissioning instruction and internal recipients

steps.what: Deliver the approved final technical instruction to the designated internal commissioning crew
inputs: approved final commissioning instruction and internal recipients
outputs: delivered final commissioning instruction

steps.what: Capture and approve actual crew responses, observed results and unresolved commissioning conditions
inputs: delivered final commissioning instruction
actual crew responses and observed commissioning evidence
outputs: approved final actual commissioning direction note

steps.what: Save the approved final commissioning direction note
inputs: approved final actual commissioning direction note
outputs: saved actual commissioning direction record

tasks.design: Configure native equipment-to-current-procedure links in {PROJECT} and {ENGINEERING_DOCUMENT_SYSTEM}, denoted OTHER. Reduce source navigation only. The manager inspects, decides and writes/checks technical instructions before separate delivery; actual responses and results are captured later. No automatic control or commissioning release occurs; same-system save stays full.
tasks.previous_blocker: Retrieving the correct drawing and commissioning procedure versions may require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project/document links can connect exact equipment versions to existing procedures.
tasks.still_hard: Technical judgement during erection and commissioning of connected mechanical/electrical systems.
tasks.human_edge: The manager understands actual installation conditions and escalation needs.
tasks.altitude: Human technical direction with current approved source retrieval.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: engineering document systems can link equipment identifiers to current approved drawing and procedure versions.

assumptions: Shares are provisional; verify residual current-version retrieval after native document tools. Existing links and rendering earn no new benefit.

Engineering and commissioning owners supply normal existing equipment_id, configuration_revision, drawing_revision and procedure_version. s1 retains exact equipment/version checks; missing links require manual source verification. No new upstream capture is assumed.

s3 captures/checks the complete actual instruction and internal recipients at full time. s5 records actual response and evidence after delivery, not assumed commissioning success. External contractors require external authority and recipient review for that instruction. Every changed instruction returns to s3; save stays full.
unknowns: Actual retrieval effort and technical authority
research_questions: Which approved erection/commissioning sources still need manual version searches?

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete final technical instruction and exact internal recipients
s5 actual final commissioning direction note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only source retrieval changes: 15 times 30% = 4.5 hours less 1 upkeep = 3.5. Low halves retrieval benefit: 2.25 minus 1 = 1.25.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise hydroelectric equipment installation, upgrades and maintenance.

steps.what: Review current installation, upgrade or maintenance work orders and equipment conditions through native asset links
inputs: actual current work orders and equipment histories
existing approved work scope and constraints
outputs: manager-checked work supervision context

steps.what: Supervise actual equipment work, inspect progress and assess quality and operational coordination
inputs: manager-checked work supervision context
actual work, equipment condition and crew explanations
outputs: actual work observations and supervisor decisions

steps.what: Write and approve final corrective instructions, work limits and designated internal crew recipients
inputs: actual work observations and supervisor decisions
outputs: approved final equipment work instructions and recipients

steps.what: Deliver the approved final equipment work instructions to the designated internal crew
inputs: approved final equipment work instructions and recipients
outputs: delivered final equipment work instructions

steps.what: Capture and approve actual work progress, crew responses and unresolved equipment issues
inputs: actual work observations and supervisor decisions
delivered final equipment work instructions
actual crew responses
outputs: approved final actual equipment supervision note

steps.what: Save the approved final equipment supervision note
inputs: approved final actual equipment supervision note
outputs: saved actual equipment supervision record

tasks.design: Configure native asset/work-order links in {MAINTENANCE_SYSTEM}, denoted OTHER. Retrieve existing scope and history with less navigation while retaining actual supervision and quality judgement. Final corrective instructions are approved before separate internal delivery. Capture actual work afterwards; same-system save earns no benefit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Work order and equipment history may require repeated navigation before supervision.
tasks.enabler_now: Native asset links can group the current work scope and equipment history.
tasks.still_hard: Judging actual installation/maintenance quality and coordinating operational constraints.
tasks.human_edge: The manager sees incomplete or inappropriate work in its physical context.
tasks.altitude: Human equipment work supervision with current work context.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: maintenance systems can link existing work orders to equipment history and approved scope.

assumptions: All shares are provisional; confirm remaining retrieval after existing native work-order views. Physical supervision and current scheduling runtime earn no new benefit.

Maintenance/project owners produce existing asset_id, work_order_id, scope_version and reported_status in normal work records. s1 retains checking and missing-data follow-up; no extra upstream capture is assumed.

s3 retains actual final instruction writing/checking. s5 captures actual observation_time, observed_progress, crew_response and unresolved_issue after supervision and delivery at full time. A planned work order does not mean completed work. Save remains full.
research_questions: What work-order or equipment-history retrieval remains manual after native maintenance views?

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete final equipment work instructions and internal recipients
s5 actual final equipment supervision note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only source retrieval changes: 10 times 30% = 3 hours less 0.5 upkeep = 2.5. Low halves retrieval benefit: 1.5 minus 0.5 = 1.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Human hydroelectric operating and engineering oversight with checked native evidence.
reach: Less repeated comparison and current-source retrieval
skills_to_grow: Checking equipment source versions and actual progress
role.ambitious_version: The manager uses native records for genuine residual comparisons while retaining every physical inspection, engineering decision and crew direction.
